headline: Rejected squeeze ($2.39) back-testing the $1.94-2.00 shelf
liquidity_note: ⚠ transition — rejected squeeze, the $1.94 shelf decides the next leg

meta.market_state_note: A -60% downtrend was broken by a violent +60% squeeze to $2.39, but the move was rejected at the $2.36-2.49 supply and has given back ~70%. Price is balancing on the $1.94-2.00 shelf / daily 20-EMA. Genuinely two-sided — the shelf decides the next leg.

pattern_candidates.name: Structure Shift
pattern_candidates.summary: Regime break confirmed with strong follow-through, but price has retraced ~70% and acceptance at supply remains unproven.
evidence: Prior downtrend clearly established; the squeeze broke its lower-high structure and cleared 1.74 and 2.00.
Printed a major higher high at 2.391 on climax volume (68M day) — a genuine regime break.
Daily 20-EMA reclaimed; daily RSI lifted out of oversold (50.9, back above its MA).
missing: No acceptance — rejected at supply and retraced ~70%, with no confirmed higher low yet.
Matters: a structure shift needs the new structure to hold.
pattern_candidates.confluence: Supported by negative funding (-0.075%, crowded shorts) and an OI flush (15.3M → 13.0M, longs already out) — squeeze fuel if the shelf holds. Undercut by CVD making new lows with price (real selling, no absorption yet).

pattern_candidates.name: Failed Breakout / Bull Trap
pattern_candidates.summary: A clean rejection at the $2.36-2.49 supply with real selling behind it, but the trap isn't complete while the $1.94 shelf holds.
evidence: Push into the pre-crash 2.36-2.49 supply, tagged 2.391, rejected hard.
Lower highs since (2.39 → 2.27 → 2.10) and a ~70% give-back — trapped-long behaviour.
CVD making fresh lows confirms real selling on the unwind.
missing: Hasn't returned fully into prior structure — the 1.94 shelf / 1.74 launch zone still holds.
So the trap isn't yet completed.
pattern_candidates.confluence: Bearish order flow (CVD) and the clean lower-high sequence support it; the negative funding / OI flush argue against follow-through.

pattern_candidates.name: Lower-High Pullback
pattern_candidates.summary: An orderly corrective leg into the shelf, but with no compression and the EMA cluster intact, it's only a developing pullback.
evidence: Orderly LH/LL descent from 2.391 into the 1.94-2.00 shelf; price just lost the 4H 20-EMA (2.012).
4H RSI (50) rolled back under its MA (55.4) — momentum fading with the move.
missing: No compression or flag boundaries — a steady bleed, not a tight consolidation.
Still holding the 4H 50/200-EMA cluster (1.93-1.98), so the base isn't broken.
pattern_candidates.confluence: Supported by the fading momentum and CVD; weak because the shelf and EMA cluster are still intact.
